def make(n, sep, marks):

  for r in range(n): g[r][c]=8

 for ci,(x,y) in enumerate(cols):
  v=6 if ri==2 and ci==1 else 3 if ri==2 else 2 if ci==1 else None
  if v is not None:
   for i in range(a,b):
    for j in range(x,y):E[i][j]=v
print('demo_reproduced:', O==E)
T=make(28,4,[(1,12,3),(6,2,2),(6,22,2),(16,2,2),(21,12,3)])
print('test_output:')
for row in m.transform(T):print(row)
'''
